paragraphs: Padam Mobility sells software for demand responsive transport, covering both Transport à la Demande and Transport de Personnes à Mobilité Réduite services, built on algorithms that optimise vehicle routes and vehicle loading. The page describes an offer that no longer rests on fixed lines and fixed timetables, and is instead built on demand and optimised continuously according to bookings. Padam Mobility states that its solutions automate and optimise the booking and operating processes of existing TàD services and TPMR services.
The pages name Autorités Organisatrices de Mobilité, transport operators and companies as the buyers using these solutions to connect their territories and ease their operation.

The homepage says that territories deploy these solutions in France, in Europe and in the world. Padam Mobility describes an accompaniment offer running from feasibility study to support, before, during and after its solutions are put in place.

quote.text: Elle ne repose plus sur des lignes et des horaires fixes, mais se construit à la demande et est optimisée en continu en fonction des réservations.
